name: DA MISERY OBBY
desc:
🌟 **MISS DA KIND OF MISERY** 🌟

Welcome to **DA MISERY OBBY** — an obstacle course built to test your skills, patience, and determination! 💀🔥

Jump, climb, dodge, and conquer your way through challenging stages packed with obstacles, surprises, and motivational messages. Whether you're a beginner or an obby pro, every checkpoint is a reminder that **progress matters more than perfection.** 💪

✨ **FEATURES:**
🏃 Fun & challenging obstacle courses
💾 Checkpoints to save your progress
📈 Increasing difficulty as you advance
🏆 Bragging rights if you reach the end

🎮 **Think you can survive DA MISERY?** Make it through every stage and prove that you don't need to be perfect — you just need to keep going. 🔥

👍 **Like & ⭐ Favorite** the game if you enjoyed it!
👥 **Invite your friends** and race them to the finish!
